The real case reads as a broad dark rectangular rear panel, not an object visibly contained behind a front lip and inner liner. Primary frames retain rail/strip-like artifacts and do not establish outer foil → inner liner/cavity → contained case causality. Projection, ID/bounds, and test assertions passed, but they are implementation checks and cannot override direct full-size visual inspection. This is a technical visual rejection, not a user rejection.

rejectionReasons: The top seal still reads as one large rigid lid floating away, not a progressive tear front.
The body edge is a uniform cartoon sawtooth. It lacks foil thickness, underside, fold tension, and contact shadow.
The tiny case seen inside the bag becomes the full case through a visual discontinuity. Continuity is simulated rather than real.
The background and impact language are muddy and weak. The result reads as a technical demo, not a premium gacha sequence.

historicalDecisions.notes: Gate 04 rev 011 iteration 09 retargets the audited CC0 Make It Shine transition instead of redrawing it, per the user's explicit correction. Real Unity PlayMode capture at 1206x2622 / 60 fps: 207 normal-speed frames plus 0.25x tear (197) and 0.25x impact/reveal (187) passes. Iterations 01-08 remain immutable self-rejected history. Awaiting user visual approval; no build, no install.

decision.notes: Gate 04 rev 011 iteration 09 is self-rejected on full-size frame inspection. Continuity and exposure genuinely improved over iteration 08, but the audited source effect identity is absent during the tear phase, the freed foil reads as a chrome blade, and residual magenta sparkle glyphs remain. Iteration 10 is required before any approval request. Iteration 09 artifacts stay immutable labeled history.
rejectionReasons: Criterion 4 fails: the audited Make It Shine discard edge sweep is not readable during the tear phase. packDissolve is 0.00 for frames 54-96, so the source identity contributes nothing while the tear is the subject.
Criterion 2 fails: the freed foil reads as a rigid chrome blade with a smooth silhouette, not curling foil with underside, thickness and an irregular torn edge.

Criterion 5 fails: the aperture still carries four-point cyan sparkle glyphs and a residual magenta smudge, because the source lifetime gradient still passes through magenta and the symmetric star atlas frame dominates.
Criterion 5 fails at mid dissolve: the widened warm edge band degenerates into two flat cream horizontal rectangles uncorrelated with the torn contour, visible at frame 0136.
The shaped cavity still reads as a thin dark band rather than an occluding interior volume at 0.25x.

decision.notes: Gate 04 rev 011 iteration 10. The iteration-09 blocking defects are addressed at their root causes rather than by repeating a failed tweak. The Pack now visibly opens: the bag has a real interior with a back wall behind the concealed case, a tear-front cross wall, a released-end side wall, a torn-edge lip and a separate occlusion band, so the receding front face uncovers a cavity instead of shortening the silhouette. The audited discard edge sweep is evaluated in torn-contour space and driven by tearProgress, so it is visible while the Pack is still opaque and can never become a full-width horizontal rectangle. The freed strip is wider, rougher, darker underneath and curls over itself. The magenta and saturated cyan gradient segments are excluded and the flare ports render horizontal streaks instead of four-point glyphs. Continuity is unchanged except that packVisible now can only become false at packDissolve 1.0 exactly. Four polish-level residual defects are disclosed in the self-review. Awaiting explicit user visual approval; nothing installed on a device.

The retarget palette stays cooler than the source, because the source's warm dominance comes from rarity card emissive which must not appear before the authoritative receipt.

issues.note: 用户表示静态架构图难以判断。该反馈不是结构否决；evidence-only rev 2 通过动画和 contact sheet 补足判断证据，Gate 04 仍待明确审批。

Technical visual rejection: direct full-size review of R025 is controlling. evidence/04-architecture/rev-025/full-proof/normal/seven-pose-contact-sheet.png shows a flat Pack front with a large diagonal cut, not a narrow physical foil mouth. The real case reads as a broad dark rectangular rear panel, not an object visibly contained behind a front lip and inner liner. Primary frames retain rail/strip-like artifacts and do not establish outer foil → inner liner/cavity → contained case causality. Projection, ID/bounds, and test assertions passed, but they are implementation checks and cannot override direct full-size visual inspection. This is a technical visual rejection, not a user rejection.

Docs/DesignBibleAssets/collector-slab-six-products-approved.png (sha d399a782...) is absent from the working tree and was never committed. Kept as a missing historical record; the V3 slab variant does not depend on it.
